name: robots/coppolam__ros_mav_swarm_simulator
title: Coppolam ROS MAV swarm simulator (uav1)
intro: Coppolam ROS MAV swarm simulator (uav1), adapted from coppolam/ros_mav_swarm_simulator. It reads `read_odometry`; runs `set_velocity`, `enable_motors` and `land`. `set_velocity`: publish one geometry_msgs/Twist velocity command on /uav1/cmd_vel; the receipt reports the values sent and confirms transmission only, not arrival, motion or a continuous stream. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
